description: Write a pandas ETL script for media_stream that loads playback events into a date-partitioned Parquet dataset while handling late-arriving events. For a given run date (2025-04-10 in the sample) the script should: (1) read events ingested on the run date, (2) derive event_date from event_ts in UTC, (3) accept events whose event_date is within the lookback window [run_date - 2 days, run_date], (4) write events outside the window to a late_rejects file, (5) for every affected event_date, merge new events with the existing partition, deduplicate on event_id, and overwrite that partition only.
edge_cases: e4 has a +03:00 offset: 2025-04-10T01:30+03:00 is 2025-04-09T22:30Z, so it belongs to the 2025-04-09 partition
e2 at exactly midnight UTC belongs to 2025-04-10
e3 (2025-04-07) is outside the 2-day lookback and goes to late_rejects, not silently dropped
e1 is delivered twice and may also already exist in the 2025-04-08 partition; dedup must span new and existing rows
Only partitions 04-08, 04-09 and 04-10 may be rewritten
common_failure_modes: FM2: Partitioning by ingested_at or by the local date string puts e1 and e4 in the wrong day
FM3: Appending to existing partitions without dedup double counts watch_seconds
FM7: Out-of-window events dropped without a reject record
